The '''2022 Bangladeshi census''' ({{langx|bn|বাংলাদেশের আদমশুমারি ২০২২}}) was a detailed enumeration of the Bangladeshi population constituting the [[Population and housing censuses by country#Bangladesh|sixth national census]] in the country.<ref name="Init1">{{cite web |title=Population census from Jun 15, digitally |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/news/population-census-jun-15-digitally-3004621 |website=Population census from Jun 15, digitally &#124; The Daily Star |publisher=The Daily Star |access-date=13 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413221414/https://www.thedailystar.net/business/news/population-census-jun-15-digitally-3004621 |archive-date=13 April 2022 |date=13 April 2022 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Init2">{{cite web |title=Next population, housing census June 15–21 |url=https://www.newagebd.net/article/167496/next-population-housing-census-june-15-21 |website=Next population, housing census June 15–21 |publisher=New Age |access-date=13 April 2022 |date=7 April 2022 |url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220407150322/https://www.newagebd.net/article/167496/next-population-housing-census-june-15-21 |archive-date=7 April 2022 }}</ref><ref name="Init3">{{cite web |title=Sixth population and housing census 15–21 June |url=https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/sixth-population-and-housing-census-15-21-june |website=Sixth population and housing census 15–21 June &#124; Prothom Alo |publisher=Prothom Alo |access-date=13 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413221918/https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/sixth-population-and-housing-census-15-21-june |archive-date=13 April 2022 |date=8 April 2022 |url-status=live}}</ref> It was scheduled to be held in June 2022, was conducted by the [[Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics]], and the reference day used for the census was June 15, 2022.<ref name="Init1" /><ref name="Init2" /><ref name="Init3" /> It was initially scheduled to be held in 2021 but was delayed due to complications caused by the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] and a lack of equipment.

==Background==
After the [[Independence of Bangladesh]] in 1971, censuses were held in the years 1974, 1981, [[1991 Census of Bangladesh|1991]], [[2001 Census of Bangladesh|2001]], and [[2011 Census of Bangladesh|2011]]. The last census taken in the country was the [[2011 Census of Bangladesh|2011 census]], which recorded a total population of 144.0 million (this figure, however, was estimated by the Bureau to have been an undercount, and the actual population was estimated to be 149.8 million).<ref name="2011Pop">{{cite web |title=POPULATION & HOUSING CENSUS 2011 NATIONAL REPORT, VOLUME – 1 ANALYTICAL REPORT |url=http://203.112.218.65:8008/WebTestApplication/userfiles/Image/PopCenZilz2011/NRV-1Report2011.pdf |website=NRV-1Report2011.pdf |publisher=Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220404115714/http://203.112.218.65:8008/WebTestApplication/userfiles/Image/PopCenZilz2011/NRV-1Report2011.pdf |archive-date=4 April 2022 |date=7 November 2015 |url-status=live}}</ref>

Plans were made to conduct the next census of Bangladesh in January 2021, with the master plan having been prepared in 2018.<ref name="Delays1">{{cite web |title=Population census faces further delays |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/economy/news/population-census-faces-further-delays-2187271 |website=Population census faces further delays &#124; The Daily Star |publisher=The Daily Star |access-date=13 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413222734/https://www.thedailystar.net/business/economy/news/population-census-faces-further-delays-2187271 |archive-date=13 April 2022 |date=30 September 2020 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Delays2">{{cite web |title=BBS misses population census survey schedule |url=https://www.newagebd.net/article/154206/bbs-misses-population-census-survey-schedule |website=BBS misses population census survey schedule |publisher=New Age |access-date=13 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413223243/https://www.newagebd.net/article/154206/bbs-misses-population-census-survey-schedule |archive-date=13 April 2022 |date=9 November 2021 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="Delays3">{{cite web |title=No more hurdles to population census |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/economy/news/no-more-hurdles-population-census-2975246 |website=No more hurdles to population census &#124; The Daily Star |publisher=The Daily Star |access-date=13 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413223952/https://www.thedailystar.net/business/economy/news/no-more-hurdles-population-census-2975246 |archive-date=13 April 2022 |date=4 March 2022 |url-status=live}}</ref> In October the following year, ৳1,761 crore were earmarked for the project by the [[Executive Committee of the National Economic Council]].<ref name="Delays1" /><ref name="Delays2" /><ref name="Delays3" /> However, due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics]] (BBS) was unable to conduct the census, delaying the exercise to October 2021.<ref name="Delays1" /><ref name="Delays2" />

As the October 2021 deadline approached, the BBS still was not fully prepared to conduct the census, as the government refused to purchase 395,000 [[tablet computers]] which were meant to be used in the enumeration.<ref name="Delays1" /><ref name="Delays2" /> The BBS had made changes to the 2018 master plan in June, shifting the method of the census from manual to digital, which was expected to reduce the cost of the operation by 11% to ৳1,575 crore.<ref name="Delays1" /><ref name="Delays2" /> Complications regarding equipment continued until March 2022, when the government approved the purchase of the tablets.<ref name="Delays3" /> The next month, the BBS announced the new schedule for the census.<ref name="Init1" /><ref name="Init2" /><ref name="Init3" />

==Design==
The 2022 Census of Bangladesh employed 370,000 enumerators. The exercise was also the country's first digital census,<ref name="Init1" /><ref name="Init2" /><ref name="Init3" /> making use of [[Geographic information system|GIS mapping]], tablet computers, and a [[Computer-assisted personal interviewing]] system to record data.<ref name="Init1" /><ref name="Init2" /><ref name="Init3" /> A post-census survey was conducted in 350 selected sample areas in order to ascertain the accuracy of the operation.<ref name="Init1" /> The process lasted from 15 June 2022 to 21 June 2022. The reference point of the census was 15 June 2022 at midnight.<ref name="Init2" /><ref name="Init3" />

=== Literacy ===
The literacy rate in the country has increased by 22.89%, according to the latest census. The rate of literacy was 51.77% in 2011 and it is now 74.80% in 2022.<ref name=":0" />
